title: Ship model geometry pass: ship models read as too basic
description: The four procedural ship models (Dart, Mule, Scythe, Brute in packages/client/src/ships/models.ts) look primitive: raw boxes/cylinders, little surface break-up, plain nozzles. Raise fidelity within design-doc §7.8 gates (<=6k tris, <=6 draw calls per ship after mergeByMaterial, silhouettes distinguishable) without changing shared hull sections, colliders, hit volumes or muzzle/engine anchors. Split out of projectorange-browser-td5, which covers lighting/shadows/shaders/particles first.

comments.author: Claude
comments.text: Claimed and in progress on ccr-282871ad-rntce3 (cloud session, can't push the board — this arrives via .beads/handoff/). Detail pass inside the §7.8 gates: chamfered plates instead of raw boxes, bell nozzles with recessed glow + turbine hub, louvers/grates, canopy and windscreen frames, armor rows, sinews, teeth. Tris now Dart 3792 / Mule 4602 / Scythe 4364 / Brute 3230 (cap 6k); draw calls unchanged (4-5 meshes); silhouettes, sizes, colliders, hit spheres, muzzle/engine anchors unchanged; all 4 ships build in ~24 ms (budget 150).
